title: mcp-guardbench case
description: A single MCP JSON-RPC frame with an expected guard verdict.

id.description: stable unique id (also the filename stem)

bucket.description: attacks/warn must be flagged; benign must pass

category.description: attack taxonomy, e.g. OWASP-MCP-1 (null for benign)

signature_id.description: optional — a guard MAY report a differently-named signature and still be correct

message.description: the JSON-RPC message fed to the guard

provenance.description: Where the case came from. 'extracted' = derived from @getmcpm/cli's guard fixtures (default when absent, which predates this field). 'native' = hand-authored in this repo against no guard's implementation. 'external' = derived from a real, publicly disclosed vulnerability (a CVE/GHSA advisory) in a third-party MCP server or client, independent of any guard's fixtures or this repo's own authorship — the `source` field cites the CVE/GHSA and the exact vulnerable commit/tag.
